terraform:
resource "aws_ebs_volume" "api" { encrypted = false; tags = { workload = "api" } }
# Complete scoped plan: api only. No public endpoints, security group ingress or load balancers. No unknown values.
kubernetes:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: api, labels: {owner: platform}}
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: api-reader
      hostNetwork: false
      containers:
        - name: api
          securityContext: {privileged: false}
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: "1", memory: "1Gi"}
# ClusterIP only; no Ingress or LoadBalancer resources.
# RoleBinding api-reader: get/list only on configmaps; no ClusterRoleBindings.
audit: api has public IPv4/IPv6 ingress and unencrypted volume. Dedicated read-only service account; no privileged containers. Owner label: platform.
